scope: Current v4 face-swap branch, public whole photos, any checked face above app line
measurement: Earlier in the same local review session on 2026-11-04; application code and weights unchanged
command: python -m src.eval.face_swap_robustness --model v4:weights/face_pe_v4/pe_step14000.pt:weights/face_pe_v4/head_facepe.pt:0.22257614135742188 --sets 'REAL polished dev' 'REAL OpenImages unseen' 'SWAPS OpenForensics test' --n 30 --versions original whatsapp small phone
unit: photo with at least one flagged face; not per-face recall or whole-ensemble verdict

versions.whatsapp: Long side at most 1600 px; JPEG quality 75
versions.small: Long side at most 800 px; JPEG quality 60
versions.phone: Deterministic simulated beauty, tone or portrait processing using the existing script

limitations: Small selected evaluation; no population-level false-alarm guarantee
Phone processing is simulated, not images collected from physical phone cameras
Uses test data for evaluation only; evaluated photos must stay out of training
